reply_text: @marcus.lindqvist The main contact is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Dana posted in this channel on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. In that case the same trailer showed up as two rows: the driver checked in at the kiosk, and then dispatch added him by hand. Dana is the account owner and said she'd look into it, so she's your internal contact for it.
